title: Third Conditional: Imagining Alternative Past Outcomes, Lessons & Regrets
group: B1.3 - Critical Perspectives & Bridge to B2
objective: Menguasai pengandaian masa lalu yang tidak mungkin terulang kembali menggunakan pola If + had + V3, would have + V3.

theory.summary: Third Conditional digunakan untuk membayangkan hasil yang berbeda dari situasi masa lalu yang sudah tidak mungkin diubah. Struktur ini berguna saat kita ingin mengungkapkan penyesalan, pelajaran hidup, atau menganalisis 'apa yang seharusnya terjadi jika...'. Berbeda dengan Second Conditional yang membicarakan situasi hipotetis saat ini, Third Conditional fokus pada masa lalu yang sudah terlanjur terjadi.
rules: Pola dasar: If + Subject + had + V3 (Past Participle), Subject + would have + V3. Contoh: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
Klausa 'if' menggunakan Past Perfect (had + V3) untuk menunjukkan kondisi masa lalu yang tidak terpenuhi. Klausa hasil menggunakan would/could/might + have + V3.
Urutan klausa bisa dibalik: She would have arrived on time if she had left earlier. Jika klausa 'if' di tengah, tidak perlu koma.
Kontraksi alami dalam percakapan: would've = would have, could've = could have, should've = should have, hadn't = had not. Contoh: If you'd called me, I would've helped you.
Gunakan 'could have' untuk kemungkinan atau kemampuan masa lalu: If he had trained more, he could have won the competition. Gunakan 'might have' untuk kemungkinan yang lebih rendah.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Jebakan: Mencampur Tenses dengan Second Conditional
commonTrap.explanation: Kesalahan umum adalah menggunakan 'would' di klausa 'if' atau mencampur struktur dengan Second Conditional. Ingat: klausa 'if' HARUS menggunakan 'had + V3', bukan 'would have'.
commonTrap.wrong: If I would have known about the meeting, I would have attended it.
commonTrap.correct: If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it.

dialogue.context: Sarah dan Tom sedang membicarakan keputusan karir Sarah yang tidak jadi pindah ke luar negeri tahun lalu. Mereka merefleksikan apa yang mungkin terjadi jika Sarah mengambil keputusan berbeda.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: You know, I sometimes wonder what would've happened if I had accepted that job offer in Singapore last year.
lines.translation: Kamu tahu, aku kadang bertanya-tanya apa yang akan terjadi kalau aku menerima tawaran pekerjaan di Singapura tahun lalu.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Yeah, I remember that. If you had taken it, you would have been earning twice your current salary by now.
lines.translation: Ya, aku ingat itu. Kalau kamu mengambilnya, kamu sudah akan mendapat gaji dua kali lipat dari sekarang.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: True, but I wouldn't have met my current boyfriend if I had moved abroad. That's something I don't regret.
lines.translation: Benar, tapi aku tidak akan bertemu pacar sekarang kalau aku pindah ke luar negeri. Itu hal yang tidak aku sesali.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's a good point. Plus, if you hadn't stayed here, you might not have gotten the promotion last month.
lines.translation: Itu poin yang bagus. Lagipula, kalau kamu tidak tinggal di sini, kamu mungkin tidak akan mendapat promosi bulan lalu.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Exactly! If I had left, someone else would have taken my position. Everything happens for a reason.
lines.translation: Tepat sekali! Kalau aku pergi, orang lain akan mengambil posisiku. Semuanya terjadi karena suatu alasan.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I agree. Still, if you'd prepared a pros and cons list back then, the decision might have been easier.
lines.translation: Aku setuju. Namun, kalau kamu membuat daftar untung rugi waktu itu, keputusannya mungkin lebih mudah.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: You're right. If I had analyzed it more carefully, I wouldn't have stressed so much about it.
lines.translation: Kamu benar. Kalau aku menganalisisnya lebih hati-hati, aku tidak akan stres sebegitu tentang hal itu.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Well, what's done is done. But hey, if things hadn't worked out this way, we wouldn't be having coffee together right now!
lines.translation: Yah, yang sudah terjadi ya sudah. Tapi hei, kalau semuanya tidak berjalan seperti ini, kita tidak akan sedang ngopi bersama sekarang!

speakingLab.context: Anda akan berdiskusi dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang penyesalan dan pelajaran hidup dari masa lalu. Mr. Khoirul akan menanyakan pengalaman Anda, dan Anda akan berlatih menggunakan Third Conditional untuk mengekspresikan situasi alternatif yang mungkin terjadi.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're going to reflect on past decisions. Tell me, is there a decision from your past that you sometimes think about differently now?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I think about the time when I didn't study abroad during university. If I had applied for that exchange program, I would have experienced living in another country.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Interesting! So you regret not applying? What stopped you at that time?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I was worried about the costs. If I had known there were scholarships available, I could have applied for financial support.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. But surely there were some positive outcomes from staying, right? What would you have missed if you had gone abroad?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That's true. If I had left, I wouldn't have met some of my closest friends here. I also wouldn't have had the internship that led to my current job.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent reflection! So what's the main lesson you learned from this experience?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I learned that if I had done more research back then, I would have made a more informed decision. But I also learned that every choice leads to different opportunities, and we can't predict everything.

quiz.question: If she ___ the alarm clock last night, she wouldn't have overslept this morning.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'had set' (Past Perfect) di klausa 'if' untuk Third Conditional. Ini menunjukkan kondisi masa lalu yang tidak terpenuhi (dia tidak memasang alarm). Pola: If + had + V3, would have + V3.

quiz.question: They would have won the competition if they ___ more effectively as a team.
quiz.explanation: Klausa 'if' dalam Third Conditional memerlukan Past Perfect (had + V3). 'Had worked' menunjukkan bahwa mereka tidak bekerja secara efektif di masa lalu, dan itu mempengaruhi hasil kompetisi.

quiz.question: If I ___ about the traffic jam, I ___ an earlier train.
quiz.explanation: Kedua bagian kalimat harus mengikuti struktur Third Conditional: If + had + V3 (had known), would have + V3 (would have taken). Ini mengungkapkan penyesalan tentang masa lalu yang tidak bisa diubah.

quiz.question: She ___ her phone if she had been more careful with her belongings.
quiz.explanation: Klausa hasil dalam Third Conditional menggunakan 'would(n't) have + V3'. Bentuk negatif 'wouldn't have lost' menunjukkan hasil yang berbeda jika kondisi masa lalu terpenuhi (kalau dia lebih hati-hati).

quiz.question: If we ___ the instructions carefully, we ___ so many mistakes in the project.
quiz.explanation: Pola lengkap Third Conditional: If + had + V3, would(n't) have + V3. 'Had read' di klausa 'if' dan 'wouldn't have made' di klausa hasil menunjukkan analisis kesalahan masa lalu dan hasil alternatif yang mungkin terjadi.
